info.name: Schedula Availability Expansion E2E
info.description:
Fully automated Collection Runner suite for PATCH /doctor/availability/:id/expand.

Prerequisites:
1. Set doctorEmail/doctorPassword/patientEmail/patientPassword to existing users with profiles.
2. Run Collection Runner top-to-bottom (folder order 1->9).
3. baseUrl default http://localhost:3000

Idempotency: re-expanding an identical window returns 400 (codebase assertStrictSupersetExpansion).

Slots verification uses GET /patient/appointments/slots?doctorId=&date=
